draw_potential_trap_positions.label: Draw Potential Trap Positions
draw_potential_trap_positions.tooltip: Enables drawing of potential trap spawn locations within range.

draw_outline_for_complex_mode.label: Draw outline in complex draw mode
draw_outline_for_complex_mode.tooltip: Draw outlines when using the complex renderer, so you can see them through walls

trap_draw_range.label: Trap Draw Range
trap_draw_range.tooltip: The radius (in yalms) around the player to highlight known potential trap positions.

trap_draw_color.label: Trap Draw Color
trap_draw_color.tooltip: Color used to display regular trap markers.

big_trap_draw_color.label: Big Trap Draw Color
big_trap_draw_color.tooltip: Color used to display larger or more dangerous trap markers.

draw_small_trap_range.label: Draw explosion range for small traps
draw_small_trap_range.tooltip: This only renders for discovered traps. Range is still being finalized.

draw_big_trap_range.label: Draw explosion range for big traps
draw_big_trap_range.tooltip: This only renders for discovered traps. Range is still being finalized.

draw_element_sectors.label: Draw elemental sectors (thunder/fire/ice)
draw_element_sectors.tooltip: Draw elemental sectors in Magic/Super Magic Tower (60 degree cone + opposite; thunder=blue-violet, fire=orange, ice=cyan)

draw_element_rings.label: Draw elemental rings
draw_element_rings.tooltip: Draw elemental ring hit areas (same shape as sectors)

element_draw_range.label: Element draw range
element_draw_range.tooltip: Radius around the player for drawing elemental zones (meters)

stop_rendering_complete_groups.label: Stop rendering discovered groups
stop_rendering_complete_groups.tooltip: Stop rendering trap locations for fully discovered groups. This feature is a work in progress.
